'''Garbat''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was at the center of the [[Pamorjal system/Legends|Pamorjal system]] and was orbited by nine [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Pamorjal]].
